interpretation_guards: The 6 kL/month requirement is per household, not per person.
Do not use the repealed 2001 GNR 509 values as the current basic-service threshold.
The 358-days/year availability and 48-consecutive-hour interruption requirements are separate gates.
A monthly volume pass cannot compensate for a flow, continuity, quality or access failure.
The 15 L/person/day emergency alternative-supply quantity is assessed at designated delivery points, not assumed at household fixtures.
Unknown or stale drinking-water quality evidence is not a pass and is not a confirmed physical contamination failure.
Private stored water, borehole water and greywater output do not receive drinking-water credit solely from source or volume.
Regulation 27 progressive compliance plans, where evidenced and approved, must be recorded separately from observed service outcomes.
This profile is a benchmark interpretation, not legal advice, municipal compliance evidence, plumbing approval or product certification.

external_context_not_legal_thresholds.note: WHO service-level context is not a substitute for the South African household-based statutory requirements.

claim_ceiling: No physical household performance, municipal compliance, drinking-water safety, product certification or local installation permission is established by this profile.

drinking_water_quality_reference.legal_reference: Government Gazette 52814 / GoN 6292 defines SANS 241 as the South African drinking-water standard as may be updated.
drinking_water_quality_reference.revision_guard: Confirm the current controlled SANS publication and applicable clauses before conformity assessment; do not hardcode parameter limits from explanatory presentations.

concepts: mandatory process-risk parameters and routine monitoring
system-specific risk-defined parameters selected by risk assessment
separate system classification for water supply, borehole, mobile tanker and static tank contexts where applicable
management of non-compliant results, corrective action and verification
monitoring_model.applicability_guard: The exact monitoring obligations, parameters, sample locations and frequencies are determined by the current SANS text and the qualified programme for the actual source/system. No universal sample TTL is imposed here.

source_to_use_guards: A sample observation is bound to its exact source/system, sample point and collection time.
Evidence at one boundary does not qualify a different downstream boundary without an explicit validated transfer or downstream sample.

A source switch, unqualified blend, treatment bypass, material treatment fault or relevant storage event invalidates automatic reuse of prior evidence; the resulting state is Unknown until requalification.
Physical delivery remains observable even when quality is Unknown or KnownNonCompliance; it receives no drinking-water service credit without the applicable qualification.
Non-potable reuse qualification never implies drinking-water qualification.

benchmark_cases.title: Basic formal-settlement service profile
benchmark_cases.observation_window: full calendar year plus each calendar month
benchmark_cases.expected_semantics: Evaluate each requirement independently. A single hard-gate failure is reported even when other measures pass; Unknown quality is not a potable pass.

adversarial_variants.condition: Monthly quantity meets 6 kL but one interruption lasts 49 consecutive hours.
adversarial_variants.expected: Quantity may pass; continuity gate fails independently.

adversarial_variants.condition: Annual availability is 357 days while monthly quantity and flow pass.

benchmark_cases.title: Alternative drinking water after interruption exceeds 48 hours
benchmark_cases.expected_semantics: Evaluate alternative supply at designated delivery points. Do not infer delivery at household fixtures. Preserve access burden and actual receipt separately.

adversarial_variants.condition: 49-hour outage; 15 L/person/day is offered at the designated point and quality evidence is current.
adversarial_variants.expected: Alternative-supply profile can qualify at that point only.

adversarial_variants.condition: Same quantity is logged in a tanker depot but no designated-point delivery is evidenced.
adversarial_variants.expected: No delivery-point service credit; state Unknown.

benchmark_cases.title: Interim informal-settlement delivery-point access
benchmark_cases.expected_semantics: Keep each delivery/access condition independent. A private household buffer is not a substitute for the interim public-service profile.

adversarial_variants.condition: Delivery point is 199 m from the furthest household.
adversarial_variants.expected: Distance gate may pass if measurement method and origin are valid.

adversarial_variants.condition: Delivery point is 201 m from the furthest household.

benchmark_cases.title: Public-to-private boundary attribution
benchmark_cases.expected_semantics: A restriction at the user connection and a restriction inside household plumbing are distinct observations. Attribute only to the evidenced boundary.

adversarial_variants.condition: Pressure is low at user connection and fixture.
adversarial_variants.expected: Evidence supports an upstream/user-connection constraint; do not infer the exclusive cause without further evidence.

adversarial_variants.condition: User connection pressure passes but fixture pressure fails.
adversarial_variants.expected: Do not attribute the fixture shortfall to the utility from these measurements alone.

benchmark_cases.title: Drinking-water quality evidence absent or stale
benchmark_cases.expected_semantics: Retain delivered physical litres but assign no confirmed potable-service credit when quality evidence is missing, stale or mis-scoped. State Unknown, not confirmed contamination.

adversarial_variants.condition: A historic sample exists but the monitoring programme is overdue.
A current sample exists for a different storage tank or outlet.
